# Draft:ARM'S KING

ARM'S KING is a Pakistani snack food manufacturing and export company headquartered in Karachi, Pakistan. Established with a vision to deliver affordable, high-quality ready-to-fry snacks, the brand has emerged as a leading name in Pakistan’s snack industry, specializing in innovative potato-based products such as slanty chips, pani puri (golgappay), and flavored 3D-shaped papad fryums.
The company focuses on combining traditional Pakistani flavors with creative shapes, offering products like football-shaped papads, heart-shaped fryums, and crinkle-cut potato chips, which cater to both household consumers and bulk buyers such as restaurants and caterers. Armskings.com adheres to stringent international quality standards, including ISO 9001:2015, FSMS 22000:2018, and Halal certifications, ensuring compliance with global food safety protocols.
ARM'S kING operates through its parent entity Arms Snacks Foods and collaborates with sibling companies like Rizwan Makhdoom & Co., emphasizing sustainable production practices and premium ingredients. The brand has expanded its reach beyond Pakistan, exporting to markets in the United States, United Kingdom, Saudi Arabia, and other regions.
To enhance accessibility, the company provides a streamlined online ordering platform via its official website and a dedicated Chrome extension, enabling customers to browse and purchase products directly. Its active social media presence and promotional deals, such as family bundles priced at 1,750 PKR, further bolster its popularity among domestic consumers.
[https://armskings.com ArmsKings] is recognized for its commitment to innovation, quality, and customer-centric values, solidifying its reputation as a pioneer in Pakistan’s snack food sector.
